title: Shared Spatial Rooms · v0.10.11
changes: Spatial shape sorter: draw rectangles or triangles with two-hand gestures; glow-edged cuboid and triangular-prism bins only accept matching shapes
Admin chooses private/shared access for each encrypted provider key; existing stored credentials are preserved and never sent to browsers
Aholo Lux3D requests explicit GLB output and reports actual task failure and task ID, rather than generic check-provider-account errors
Desktop Collection fills the window with a source/child image carousel, swipe navigation and filmstrip; XR cinema supports previous/next without exiting
Settings, diagnostic modals and Personal Archive retain their headers while scrolling
Private/public headset room prompt, signed-in user room browser, invitations, explicit join and read-only desktop spectator of live headset and card placement
Shared scenes use bounded SQLite state updates and source-scoped image reads; ordinary personal object/image endpoints remain private
